public_rationale: On October 2, 2024, Zitron wrote that once OpenAI had raised its current $6.5 billion to $7 billion round, it would have to raise another round at least as large by July 2025. OpenAI announced that round, at $6.6 billion, the same day. On December 27, 2024, OpenAI said it needed to raise more capital. On March 31, 2025, it announced $40 billion in new funding, and SoftBank disclosed a signed agreement with a $10 billion first closing planned for mid-April 2025. All of this is before the end of July 2025, and both amounts exceed $6.6 billion.
limitations: OpenAI's statement that it needed more capital is a company disclosure. It does not show that OpenAI could not have continued without new money, and this record does not assess that.
This record does not assess Zitron's wider reasoning about OpenAI's finances.
SoftBank's release gives the April 2025 first closing as planned. This packet does not include a document confirming that the payment completed.
Most of the $40 billion was scheduled after the horizon and was conditional on a restructuring. The threshold is met by the first closing alone.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Once OpenAI has raised its current round of $6.5 billion to $7 billion, it will have to raise another round of at least the same size by July 2025, if not sooner.
conditions: once it has raised its current ($6.5 billion to $7 billion) round

statement.excerpt: I believe that OpenAI, once it has raised its current ($6.5 billion to $7 billion) round, will have to raise another round of at least the same size by July 2025, if not sooner.

from_speaker: once it has raised its current ($6.5 billion to $7 billion) round
will have to raise another round
of at least the same size
our_interpretation: 'Will have to raise' has two parts: that OpenAI would need another round, and that it would raise one. Public evidence can show the second: whether and when a round was announced and signed. It can show the first only as far as OpenAI itself said it needed to raise capital. It cannot show whether OpenAI could have continued without the money, because OpenAI publishes no audited accounts.
We read the antecedent as met when OpenAI announced that its current round had been raised.
We read 'at least the same size' as at least $6.6 billion, the size OpenAI announced for that round.
We read 'by July 2025' as on or before 2025-07-31.
We count a round as raised when OpenAI announces it and an investor discloses a signed agreement with a first closing planned inside the horizon.
criteria.support_condition: The antecedent is met, and between the close of that round and 2025-07-31 OpenAI raised a new round of at least $6.6 billion, and OpenAI stated in that period that it needed to raise more capital.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The antecedent is met, and by 2025-07-31 OpenAI had raised no new round of at least $6.6 billion.

evidence.explanation: OpenAI said on December 27, 2024, inside the horizon, that it needed to raise more capital. This is the company's own statement of need. It gives no amount and does not show that OpenAI could not have continued without new money.
